guidance_added: Background run_process jobs are joined before the agent run completes and are not persistent-server mode.
timeout_ms must cover process startup and execution; a short timeout can retire the process tree and quarantine uncertain effects.
A server intended to outlive the agent run must be started from the session Terminal UI, and its ready URL must be verified.
limitations: This clarifies existing bounded background-process semantics; it does not add an agent-managed persistent service lifecycle.
